name: Agreeing-Blocks Ample Class
definition: Let $D=\{0,1\}^3\setminus\{111\}$ and $s=110$. On two disjoint three-coordinate blocks take $C_{\mathrm{ab}}=(D\times\{s\})\cup(\{s\}\times D)$.
properties: It has thirteen concepts, is geometrically realizable and ample, belongs to the maximum-generated class, and is dismantlable ample. Its Horn-renaming defect is exactly one, so no coordinate reflection is a conditional antimatroid.
